server.concurrency: Goroutine per request, scheduled on all CPUs
server.tuning: GOMAXPROCS = CPUS; pgx pool of DB_POOL connections

server.concurrency: Platform thread per request (Tomcat worker pool)
server.tuning: Tomcat defaults (max 200 threads); HikariCP pool of DB_POOL connections; -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=75

server.concurrency: Virtual thread per request (Tomcat on virtual threads)
server.tuning: spring.threads.virtual.enabled=true (unbounded virtual threads, carriers = CPUs); HikariCP pool of DB_POOL connections; -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=75

server.concurrency: Single-threaded event loop per process; CPUS processes via node:cluster
server.tuning: node:cluster forks CPUS workers sharing port 8080; pg pool of max(1, floor(DB_POOL / CPUS)) connections per worker

server.concurrency: asyncio event loop (uvloop) per process; CPUS uvicorn worker processes
server.tuning: uvicorn --workers CPUS; asyncpg pool of max(1, DB_POOL / CPUS) connections per worker

server.concurrency: Tokio work-stealing async tasks on CPUS worker threads
server.tuning: Tokio multi-thread runtime with worker_threads = CPUS; sqlx pool of DB_POOL connections
